items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Freddie and I were good friends, we were good friends.

ctx.x: Freddie Hubbard. We just lost Freddie Hubbard too.
Oh, Freddie Hubbard was, he got famous, he got up there, Freddie Hubbard was something else, man. But he was a wild dude too. [laughs]
